name: IVR
tagline: International representation body for inland waterway transport and maritime safety
hero_kpi_rationale: L'organisation représente les intérêts du secteur européen du transport fluvial et démontre son engagement actif à travers une participation massive à son congrès annuel, reflétant la solidité de son réseau et de son influence institutionnelle.

kpis.explanation: Total number of participants attending the annual IVR Congress from multiple European countries.
kpis.signal: Strong industry engagement and institutional influence
kpis.description: 225 participants from 11 different countries attended the 2024 IVR Congress in Frankfurt (May 15-17), representing active members and industry stakeholders engaged with the organization.

kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium, the organization's first dedicated technical conference.
kpis.signal: Successful launch of specialized technical platform
kpis.description: 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands, and Germany attended the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium in Antwerp (November 4, 2024), covering technical and financial aspects of loss prevention in European inland waterway transport.

kpis.explanation: Number of European countries represented in the association's membership.
kpis.description: IVR represents members and stakeholders from 11 different European countries, demonstrating its role as a truly international organization for inland waterway transport interests across Europe.
